name: Santa Cruz Tree Inventory
prompt: i'd like an app that is about trees in a city - where the size, age, type, and status of the trees is shown and a map shows where they are all located. make the city santa cruz, ca.

thought_process.interpretation: I interpreted the request as a 'Data Explorer' archetype for a City Arborist or Environmental Planner. The app focuses on monitoring the health, size, and geographic distribution of the tree canopy in Santa Cruz, CA.
assumed_from_scratch: Santa Cruz coordinate bounding box for geographic scatter plotting
Tree-specific health scoring and age categorization logic
Local Santa Cruz tree species list (Redwood, Oak, Cypress, etc.)
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'Local City Map' skill that handles coordinate-to-grid mapping for city-level data would be highly beneficial to avoid using generic scatter charts for geographic data.
